title: Unit Event — Grow Glorious Glow — Episode3 A Big Gap

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! haven't received any job offers in a while, but one day, an email arrives for Shizuku. It invites her to audition for popular cosmetics brand Grand Fleur's new commercial...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I think that was the best run we've had of it so far.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Then, let's take a ten-minute break, but let's not forget how that felt!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Shizuku, that reminds me!
Have you heard back about your audition yet?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, I haven't heard back from them...
It's been almost a week, so I think it should be soon...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, it's best not to dwell on this stuff! You know what they say! Good things come to those who wait.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Shizuku!
The results of that audition just came in!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Really...?!
It's wonderful to hear that you passed.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And you're gonna be working with Hagiyama from ReLight, right?! She seems like the perfect choice, since she has such a nice shine to her! Now I can't wait to see your commercial!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me neither. There's no doubt that she's good, so I'm sure you two are going to produce a great commercial.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, you don't seem all that happy for some reason. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm afraid that I'm going to ruin this commercial.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ruin it? What makes you think that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because Hagiyama was truly overwhelming during that audition...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I took one look at her and realized that she possesses something which I don't.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm honestly wondering if I have what it takes to be paired with her...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Slow down...!
What do you mean you don't have what it takes? That's ridiculous—

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That's just the truth of it.
She stands miles ahead of me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: In other words, this Hagiyama girl must really be something else.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, if I keep feeling this way, it's definitely going to negatively affect the quality of our commercial.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They chose me, so I need to do my best to make it as good as I possibly can.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay...
But you shouldn't have to carry this all on your own.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What she said. We're here to help, so ask us if you ever need any!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We should be able to give you some assistance by watching you pose and such...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(We start shooting in just a few weeks.
I honestly don't know how much I'll be able to improve by then.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But if it means getting even a little bit closer to the brilliance Hagiyama possesses...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(I have to try...!
For the sake of MORE MORE JUMP!)
